basics.name: Amer Hamdan
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Tech Lead
basics.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · Tech Lead · AI-Product Development
basics.availability: Open to senior full-stack, tech lead, and AI-product roles — remote or Istanbul.
basics.thesis: Ten years of shipping and re-shipping production web systems: news platforms, global hiring marketplaces, a restaurant SaaS with 1,000+ active users. Most of the work is migration — taking something slow and legacy and rebuilding it without ever turning it off.
basics.summary: Senior full-stack engineer and team lead with ten years building and rebuilding production web platforms across news, recruitment, healthcare research, and SaaS. Leads small teams through legacy migrations — PHP to Laravel, WordPress to Next.js — and ships the result with measurable gains in performance, engagement, and delivery rate. Comfortable owning the whole path: data model, API, interface, cloud deployment, and the SEO and Core Web Vitals work that decides whether anyone finds the product at all.

metrics.label: Sites delivered
metrics.note: As team lead at Alpha Creative

work.name: ID8 Media
work.summary: Lead engineer across the agency's product portfolio — multi-client platforms, newsroom tooling, and large-scale hiring products.
highlights: Raised project success rate 25% by leading development teams through 5 complex, concurrent client builds.
Improved software efficiency 15% for news agencies by engineering tailored publishing and content-delivery solutions.
Built large-scale global hiring platforms handling multi-region job data and employer workflows.
Own the delivery pipeline for multi-client sites: architecture, code review, deployment, and post-launch performance.
